followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the included Khunjerab passenger restriction and its formal easing endpoint. The policy was distinct from routine winter closure and from the cargo channel. Retain ordinary passenger entry and exit only in SA028-FU1. Earlier two-way freight return and temporary emergency people/goods passages remain explicit exceptions to any whole-border interpretation. Retain 3 April 2023 as the official passenger-resumption endpoint with unknown non-seasonal onset and no numeric duration. The seasonal calendar and exceptional openings prevent a single uninterrupted three-year all-traffic interval. Retain Health and biosecurity / Human disease control as the source-attributed COVID reason. Seasonal winter operation is not recoded as an additional motive for this passenger restriction. The Chinese Foreign Ministry provides a primary retrospective policy account. It is not a gate log or independent observation of first passenger passage; older historical sources are not all recertified. Retain unlocated Khunjerab text and null coordinates. The bilateral passenger scope does not justify a whole China–Pakistan boundary geometry or transfer of cargo dates to passengers.
